name: openajang-monorepo
description: TypeScript SDK monorepo for OpenAjang: core validator and secure resolver

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @openajang/core run build && pnpm --filter @openajang/resolver run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test packages/core/tests/*.test.ts packages/resolver/tests/resolver.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @openajang/core run build && pnpm --filter @openajang/resolver run typecheck
